visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shows hands pouring white powder from a glass bowl into a large container of water and strawberries. The hands then submerge and mix the fruit vigorously in the cloudy liquid. (2) A man with medium-length curly hair, wearing a blue-and-white horizontal striped t-shirt and multiple beaded bracelets, speaks directly to the camera. He holds an electronic tablet displaying a news article with a red strawberry header. (3) The man is standing in a brightly lit indoor kitchen area. He demonstrates washing strawberries under a black faucet with a high-pressure stream of water. He holds a strawberry up to show the stem is still attached. (4) In a circular inset and then full screen, a macro shot shows his palm holding a tiny, moving brown insect near a strawberry. (5) The man introduces a clear bottle with a white label; he pours a single drop into a bowl of strawberries, which immediately creates a dense layer of white foam when mixed with water. (6) He washes the strawberries individually under running water, then bites into one and gives two thumbs-up gestures while smiling. (7) Product shots show the bottle alongside fresh apples and strawberries on a light-colored surface with green plant decorations. (8) He demonstrates the product's versatility by washing a white plate and a transparent bowl under a running tap. (9) A woman appears in the background at the kitchen sink, pointing and gesturing at the man. He turns to look at her, then faces the camera again with a forced grin while holding the product bottle.
